label: sec:enveloping-algebras
html: The enveloping algebra U(\mathfrak{su}(2)) and its q-deformation U_q(\mathfrak{su}(2)) supply the algebraic substrate for categorical braiding. We assemble the universal enveloping algebra, define the quantum group \mathrm{SU}_q(2) via the q-Casimir, and exhibit the R-matrix that realises the braiding on its representation category.
